_comment: NotebookLM stamps a wordmark bottom-right, a second one centred above the title on the opening card, and a full-frame end card. Positions are NOT hardcoded: the title-card mark sits relative to the title block, so it moved from y=100 with a one-line title to y=50 with a two-line one. Across five units a fixed box hit one, missed one entirely, and on a third stamped our logo over the title text while the original stayed visible above it. So only a SEARCH REGION is configured and the mark is measured per video by shape. A mark is also only covered where it is actually present - NotebookLM omits the bottom-right one on the title card when it shows the centred one.

bottom_right._comment: search_region is (y0, y1, x0, x1) as fractions. fallback is used only if detection finds nothing, and is the box measured from two 1600x900 samples.

centre_top._comment: Sits above the title, so its height varies with the number of title lines. Region spans y 3-32% to cover both observed positions.
